title: Late Stage Capitalism Acquisition of Mordor
subtitle: Sauron-themed Satire Continues...
body_html:
Not all that glitters is gold. At the end of the day, gold isn't particularly scalable. What was the math we had on the total addressable domination here in middle earth?

“elves, dwarves, and men. There's also niche communities like the halflings and the Ents.”

“to be clear, we're doing really well with the orcs right now?”

“orc are all in on our brand.”

“Early adopters, those orcs.”

“this is exactly my point. Our brand ambassadors are just great. Everybody knows the Nazgûl.”

“however, there's one additional thing we're gonna need from the Nazgûl team…”

“ I agree, we talked about this before, more selfies. More rizz. We need to give the fans something to edit.”

“that's the thing, we need people to understand, Sauron is Brat.”

“what does that mean?”

“well, you know, he's a little bit messy sometimes. But he really likes to bring all of metal earth under his dominion, and he buried his beef with Sauroman in a Collab they did.”

“ I'm not following…”

“ that's OK, there's just one other thing, I got a message from the board. They need us to pivot. We're calling it project pivot.”

“what is the pivot that we need to do?”

“there needs to be more than one ring”

“the board wants us to pivot away from the one ring to rule them all?”

“ yeah, they want us to move more rings. They feel like giving the ring strong identity, only one of them is a problem, because only one ring doesn't scale particularly if you can't find it. The invisibility feature also makes it really hard to take videos of people wearing the ring, and that leads to less strong performance on TikTok.”

“they want more than one, when the whole point is that there is one ring rule them all.”

“why couldn't there be a lot of rings that rule?”

“are you suggesting Sauron is a bot?”

“ all I'm saying is that more rings, from a brand identity standpoint, means more scalable. We wanna rule all the rings, but the search cost for just one ring, really hard to justify.”

“Bet.”

“so, here's the thing, we have a new ad we're rolling out on Facebook.”

“I guess that will have to do.”
